checks.name: ck_client_link_labels
checks.sql: length(gym_name::text) >= 1 AND length(gym_name::text) <= 255 AND length(client_display_name::text) >= 1 AND length(client_display_name::text) <= 200

checks.name: ck_client_link_state
checks.sql: status::text = 'pending'::text AND user_id IS NULL AND accepted_at IS NULL AND revoked_at IS NULL OR status::text = 'active'::text AND user_id IS NOT NULL AND accepted_at IS NOT NULL AND revoked_at IS NULL OR status::text = 'revoked'::text AND revoked_at IS NOT NULL AND (user_id IS NULL AND accepted_at IS NULL OR user_id IS NOT NULL AND accepted_at IS NOT NULL)

checks.name: ck_client_invitation_email
checks.sql: length(recipient_email::text) >= 3 AND length(recipient_email::text) <= 255 AND recipient_email::text = lower(TRIM(BOTH FROM recipient_email))

checks.name: ck_client_invitation_state
checks.sql: status::text = 'consumed'::text AND consumed_by IS NOT NULL AND consumed_at IS NOT NULL AND consumed_at < expires_at AND revoked_at IS NULL OR status::text = 'pending'::text AND consumed_by IS NULL AND consumed_at IS NULL AND revoked_at IS NULL OR status::text = 'revoked'::text AND consumed_by IS NULL AND consumed_at IS NULL AND revoked_at IS NOT NULL

checks.name: ck_client_publication_pdf
checks.sql: source_object_id IS NULL AND object_key IS NULL AND content_type IS NULL AND byte_size IS NULL AND sha256 IS NULL AND storage_backend IS NULL OR source_object_id IS NOT NULL AND length(source_object_id::text) = 32 AND object_key IS NOT NULL AND length(object_key::text) >= 1 AND length(object_key::text) <= 512 AND content_type IS NOT NULL AND content_type::text = 'application/pdf'::text AND byte_size IS NOT NULL AND byte_size >= 1 AND byte_size <= 67108864 AND sha256 IS NOT NULL AND length(sha256::text) = 64 AND storage_backend IS NOT NULL AND (storage_backend::text = ANY (ARRAY['local'::text, 's3'::text]))

checks.name: ck_client_publication_state
checks.sql: status::text = 'published'::text AND withdrawn_at IS NULL OR status::text = 'withdrawn'::text AND withdrawn_at IS NOT NULL

checks.name: ck_generation_completed_publication
checks.sql: publication_protocol = 0 OR status::text <> 'completed'::text OR persisted_at IS NOT NULL

checks.name: ck_generation_publication_marker
checks.sql: persisted_at IS NULL OR publication_protocol = 1 AND status::text = 'completed'::text

checks.name: ck_gym_generation_completed_result
checks.sql: status::text <> 'completed'::text OR result_json IS NOT NULL

checks.name: ck_usuario_reset_state
checks.sql: password_reset_hash IS NULL AND password_reset_expires_at IS NULL AND password_reset_session_version IS NULL OR password_reset_hash IS NOT NULL AND length(password_reset_hash::text) = 64 AND password_reset_expires_at IS NOT NULL AND password_reset_session_version IS NOT NULL AND password_reset_session_version >= 0

functions:
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.usuarios u WHERE u.id=NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_tenant',true),'')
   AND u.activo AND u.deleted_at IS NULL AND u.invitation_token IS NULL
   AND ((u.tipo='gym' AND u.role='OWNER' AND u.team_gym_id IS NULL)
     OR (u.role IN ('ADMIN','NUTRIOLOGO','VIEWER') AND (u.tipo='usuario' OR u.team_gym_id IS NOT NULL)
       AND (u.team_gym_id IS NULL OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.usuarios parent WHERE parent.id=u.team_gym_id
         AND parent.tipo='gym' AND parent.role='OWNER' AND parent.team_gym_id IS NULL
         AND parent.activo AND parent.deleted_at IS NULL AND parent.invitation_token IS NULL)))))

SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.usuarios u
  WHERE u.id=identity AND u.tipo='gym' AND u.role='OWNER' AND u.team_gym_id IS NULL
    AND u.activo AND u.deleted_at IS NULL AND u.invitation_token IS NULL)

SELECT COALESCE(l.user_id=NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_tenant',true),'') AND EXISTS(
 SELECT 1 FROM public.client_link_invitations i WHERE i.link_id=l.id AND i.gym_id=l.gym_id AND i.client_id=l.client_id
 AND i.status='consumed' AND i.consumed_by=l.user_id AND i.consumed_at=l.accepted_at AND public.r12_proof(i)),false)
value jsonb, allowed text[], required text[]

SELECT CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(value)='object' AND allowed IS NOT NULL AND required IS NOT NULL THEN
  value ?& required AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_object_keys(value) key WHERE NOT key=ANY(allowed))
  ELSE false END

SELECT CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(value)='number' AND positive IS NOT NULL THEN
  (value::text)::numeric BETWEEN 0 AND 1000000000000 AND (NOT positive OR (value::text)::numeric>0)
  ELSE false END

SELECT COALESCE(l.status='pending' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.client_link_invitations i WHERE i.link_id=l.id
  AND i.gym_id=l.gym_id AND i.client_id=l.client_id AND i.status IN ('pending','consumed') AND public.r12_proof(i)),false)

SELECT COALESCE(public.r12_actor_valid() AND i.token_hash=NULLIF(current_setting('app.client_invitation_digest',true),'')
 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.usuarios u WHERE u.id=NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_tenant',true),'')
   AND u.email=i.recipient_email AND u.email=lower(btrim(u.email)))
 AND (i.status<>'consumed' OR i.consumed_by=NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_tenant',true),'')),false)

SELECT COALESCE(p.status='published' AND public.r12_actor_valid() AND EXISTS(
 SELECT 1 FROM public.client_account_links l WHERE l.id=p.link_id AND l.gym_id=p.gym_id AND l.client_id=p.client_id
  AND l.user_id=NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_tenant',true),'') AND l.status='active'
  AND public.r12_canonical_gym(l.gym_id)),false)
BEGIN IF current_setting('transaction_isolation') IS DISTINCT FROM 'read committed' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='25000',MESSAGE='R12 requires READ COMMITTED'; END IF; END
triggers: CREATE TRIGGER r12_guard_link BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE ON public.client_account_links FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION r12_guard_link()
CREATE CONSTRAINT TRIGGER r12_link_pair AFTER UPDATE ON public.client_account_links DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION r12_check_pair()
CREATE TRIGGER r12_guard_invitation BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE ON public.client_link_invitations FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION r12_guard_invitation()
CREATE CONSTRAINT TRIGGER r12_invitation_pair AFTER UPDATE ON public.client_link_invitations DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION r12_check_pair()
CREATE TRIGGER r12_guard_publication BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE ON public.client_plan_publications FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION r12_guard_publication()
CREATE TRIGGER r12_client_invalidation AFTER UPDATE ON public.clientes FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION r12_invalidate_source()
CREATE TRIGGER r12_plan_invalidation AFTER UPDATE ON public.planes_generados FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION r12_invalidate_source()
CREATE TRIGGER r12_object_invalidation AFTER UPDATE ON public.stored_objects FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION r12_invalidate_source()
